claim: Capacity/re-entry/coupling factorial discriminates selective capacity, truth-bound re-entry and corruption-overcoupling effects.
J-space shows intermediate-depth emergence, limited capacity, broadcast-like weight organization and causal role in flexible cognition with explicit architectural limitations.
Bandwidth-limited shared workspace with competition can support specialization/compositionality/synchronization.
Global Latent Workspace can be framed as translation among specialized latent spaces.

At router AUC≈0.921 and pull sensitivity .95, selective push+pull achieved mean relevant coverage .98734 while reducing physical deliveries .67641 and irrelevant deliveries .89766 versus full broadcast.
Useful truthful-reentry delay horizon scaled strongly with process persistence; tested crossover delays 1,2,5,11,29 for rho .60,.80,.90,.95,.98.
Age-of-Information-at-Query formalizes freshness at receiver query/use time for pull-based communication and can yield different policies from indiscriminate push freshness.
workspace_broadcast is documented as the cognitive workspace with six-channel competition, configured ZUENDSCHWELLE=0.55, persistence to consciousness.db and Core read into INNER_STATE.

Configured-gate post-transition location tracked configured threshold with mean anchoring slope 0.99817±0.01116; independent pre-gate endogenous transition was invariant in the toy. Recurrent toy hysteresis increased with feedback.
With transport held successful, target-only reconstruction lesion reduced target semantic action accuracy to 0.433735±0.090740 across 120 seeds while unlesioned audiences remained at 1.0.
GNW ignition is characterized as nonlinear amplification/sustained global access associated with recurrent processing rather than merely a configured threshold label.
Ignition Index fits sigmoid steepness to representational transitions and reports stronger ignition along the iteration axis than depth axis in a depth-recurrent model; preprint evidence only.
OpenAlex, arXiv, Tavily and Exa bridge calls succeeded; Semantic Scholar returned HTTP 429; HF inference remained cached quota-exhausted.

Bundled graph+workspace+projection ablation produced ~0.2396 apparent gain when constructed true workspace effect was zero; orthogonal workspace contrast was zero. With nonzero workspace mechanism, bundled delta ~0.3113 versus isolated workspace ~0.0845.

Projection/order and contextual graph/winner metadata strongly altered deterministic selection behavior; pure order control scored 10/12 original versus 8/12 reversed and truthful-metadata arm reproducibly selected position 1 on 12/12 items with 5/12 truth.
Earlier matched-content GWT proxy measured 87.5% neutral vs 62.5% reversed order and 8/8 correct projection vs 0/8 truth under deliberately scrambled projection.

Sparse latent activation is explicitly non-authoritative and not ignition; G1d freezes graph_epoch, activation_epoch and CognitiveFrame and requires matched no-field/truthful/shuffled-field decision tests before promotion.
ACL Findings 2026 reports >14 percentage-point MCQA order gap and identifies causal attention information bottleneck as mechanism, supporting projection/order as an independent causal variable.
2026 query-aware spreading activation and ACL memory architectures demonstrate that graph activation can improve retrieval/context independently of GWT competition/ignition.
